svg.aria-label: An 8 by 8 image, its pixels numbered 0 to 63 row by row, coloured by the 4 blocks of 4 by 4 threads that cover it. Pixel 14, at column 6 and row 1, is highlighted. It belongs to block (1, 0), where the thread is at position (2, 1). Its column is 1 × 4 + 2 = 6, its row 0 × 4 + 1 = 1, and its pixel number 1 × 8 + 6 = 14.
svg.text: 4 blocks of 4 × 4 threads; each thread handles 1 pixel.
Numbers above the grid are ix, the column; numbers on its left are iy, the row.
